profile: default (no API key, no network, no model download beyond pinned artifacts)

retrieval_policy.eligibility: int-bitset AND of scopes; stats recomputed on eligible set only
retrieval_policy.term_cap: MATCH restricted to <=16 lowest-df query terms; drop terms with df > 0.25*N_E
retrieval_policy.scope: resolve named speaker/entity (name or alias) -> candidate restriction when resolvable

bm25f.candidate_lane: sqlite FTS5 bm25(tbl, per-column weights) — candidate generation only (global idf, no columnsize on <=3.44)

rescore.formula: sum_f w_f * sum_w idf_E(w) * f_wi*(k1+1) / (f_wi + k1*(1 - b_f + b_f*dl_f/avgdl_f))
rescore.b_lever: k1 near-inert at tf=1 on short turns; b is the live lever — tune b first (d4/ranx)

bm25f.eligible_df: lazy int-bitset AND + popcount per term; 13.2ms cold / 0.02ms warm @100k

fusion.default: RRF k=60 FLAT (no lane weights) when <150 judged queries
fusion.preferred: calibrated CombSUM: per-lane isotonic PAV (<=32 breakpoints) or Platt, weighted sum, unfired=0; ~10 labels/lane to fit
fusion.option: wRRF with entropy weights w_g = (1/H_g)/sum(1/H) or tuned convex (TM2C2 alpha~0.8) behind held-out gate

default.vectors: int8 256d, 25.6MB/100k, mmap-packed file layout (not SQLite blobs)
default.quality: ~0.72-0.82 of MiniLM-L6 MTEB retrieval; NanoBEIR 0.503 vs BM25 0.452

semantic_tier.hashing_lane: keep hashing:subword-ngram:v1 as free lexical lane; excluded from fusion (dilutes bm25f)
semantic_tier.ann: none — exact scan 1.19ms@100k measured; HNSW rejected (build cost + thin-shell recall collapse + eligibility conflict)

cross_encoder.pool_cap_correction: Hindsight's cap is 300 (DEFAULT_RERANKER_MAX_CANDIDATES), not 32; 32 was the predict batch — k=300 rejected (3.4s)
cross_encoder.smallest_k_rule: measure any@10 at k in {8,16,32}; ship first k within 0.005 of best

temporal.schema: said_at, valid_from, valid_until, rec_from, rec_until — i32 minutes, 2147483647 sentinel, B-tree on said_at (+valid_until)
temporal.write: newest-wins truncation: same (entity,predicate) slot with different value closes prior valid_until=new.valid_from; append-only
temporal.resolver: deterministic precision-first; anchor question ts > session start > wall-clock (live only); unambiguous-only, empty fallback
temporal.prefilter: interval containment as per-candidate eligibility (0.055ms/40 cands), never a lane (37% selectivity on open-interval stores)
temporal.decay: r = 0.5^(d/120) folded as score*(1+0.2*(r-0.5)) — bounded +-10%; alt: max(0.1, 1-d/365) linear
temporal.currently_fix: slot-key supersession at structure level — recency multipliers measured NOT to fix latest-X (0.50->0.36 synth, conditioned variant identical)
temporal.pack: date-range headers surfaced to reader (Zep's biggest measured temporal win)

graph.materialization: edges_top = top-32 claims per entity (per-node caps can't be enforced in-query; +80B/claim)
graph.expansion: 1-hop entity->claims join (0.05ms) + bounded 2-hop via edges_top (0.05-0.5ms); 2-step spreading activation scorer
graph.ppr: reject default — converged push 1.4-2.9ms only via edges_top; 2-step spread matches at 0.88 Jaccard; eligibility-leak risk

alias.canon: lowercase, strip, explicit alias table + write-time canonicalization

merge.partner_rarity: w_p = max(0, 1 - df_p/(0.01*N)) — family hubs contribute ~0

alias.rejected_prior: 0.5*name+0.3*cooc+0.2*time >=0.6 — merges homonyms (0.84), fails Bob->Robert (0.586); cannot express veto

coref.sieve: pronoun-class: it/its->unique non-person in <=3-turn lookback; person pronouns->unique person; 'i' never inherits; abstain on 2+ same-class candidates

consolidation.unit: observation = (entity, predicate) aggregate delivering pinned head-evidence bytes + proof_count + validity interval + superseded_by
consolidation.merge_gate: slot-keyed value equality required; J(word)>=0.8 only for near-verbatim repeats (measured: paraphrases 0.44 vs contradictions 0.60-0.67 — no separating threshold)
consolidation.freshness: watermark flag stale(o) iff max evidence ts > obs.as_of; always union obs with raw facts

rejected.why: unnecessary at 100k (1.19ms exact); eligibility conflict; thin-shell collapse
CC BY-NC-SA; Apache doc-side variant = optional
no separating band between paraphrase and contradiction
